title: 高可用網站架構
summary: 以SLO、失效域與有限容量網站連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect slos, failure domains and finite-capacity websites through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 服務與失效契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「服務與失效契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop service and failure contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 使用者路徑：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「使用者路徑」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for user paths.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「使用者路徑」的資料、控制與時間關係。首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for user paths. A live homepage does not establish critical-operation success. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw login, read and write paths. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。
steps.observationEn: Draw login, read and write paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩個 99.9% 元件串列仍是 99.9%。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two 99.9% components in series still yield 99.9%. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「使用者路徑」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit user paths two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 使用者路徑的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。
knowledge.textEn: A live homepage does not establish critical-operation success.

knowledge.title: 使用者路徑的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw login, read and write paths. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 30 天共 43,200 min，99.9% 可用率的時間型錯誤預算=43.2 min。假設兩元件獨立且皆 99.9%，串列 A=0.999²=99.8001%；備援才可用 1−(1−A)²，獨立假設常不成立。
knowledge.textEn: Thirty days contain 43,200 min; 99.9% time availability permits 43.2 min. Two independent 99.9% components in series yield 99.8001%; redundancy uses 1−(1−A)² only when independence assumptions apply.

quiz.question: 本步審查「使用者路徑」與整體「高可用網站架構」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing user paths within highly available website architecture, which statement or check is supported?
options: 首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。
兩個 99.9% 元件串列仍是 99.9%。
不同可用區自動排除所有共同失效。
optionsEn: A live homepage does not establish critical-operation success.
Two 99.9% components in series still yield 99.9%.
Different zones remove every common failure.
quiz.explanation: 首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: A live homepage does not establish critical-operation success. Draw login, read and write paths. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 使用者路徑：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。」檢查「使用者路徑」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for user paths using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「使用者路徑」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。 核對「首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for user paths and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw login, read and write paths. Check the principle: A live homepage does not establish critical-operation success. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。
steps.observationEn: Draw login, read and write paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩個 99.9% 元件串列仍是 99.9%。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two 99.9% components in series still yield 99.9%. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「使用者路徑」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit user paths input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.objective: 以「故障域」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for failure domains.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「故障域」的資料、控制與時間關係。副本若共用電源或控制則可能共同失效。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出共用依賴與獨立部分。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for failure domains. Replicas sharing power/control can fail together. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark shared and independent dependencies. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 標出共用依賴與獨立部分。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：不同可用區自動排除所有共同失效。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Different zones remove every common failure. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「故障域」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「副本若共用電源或控制則可能共同失效。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit failure domains two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 故障域的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 副本若共用電源或控制則可能共同失效。
knowledge.textEn: Replicas sharing power/control can fail together.

knowledge.title: 故障域的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 標出共用依賴與獨立部分。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Mark shared and independent dependencies. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「故障域」與整體「高可用網站架構」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing failure domains within highly available website architecture, which statement or check is supported?
options: 副本若共用電源或控制則可能共同失效。
兩個 99.9% 元件串列仍是 99.9%。
不同可用區自動排除所有共同失效。
optionsEn: Replicas sharing power/control can fail together.
Two 99.9% components in series still yield 99.9%.
Different zones remove every common failure.
quiz.explanation: 副本若共用電源或控制則可能共同失效。 標出共用依賴與獨立部分。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Replicas sharing power/control can fail together. Mark shared and independent dependencies. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 故障域：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「標出共用依賴與獨立部分。」檢查「故障域」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for failure domains using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「故障域」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：標出共用依賴與獨立部分。 核對「副本若共用電源或控制則可能共同失效。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for failure domains and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Mark shared and independent dependencies. Check the principle: Replicas sharing power/control can fail together. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 標出共用依賴與獨立部分。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：不同可用區自動排除所有共同失效。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Different zones remove every common failure. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「故障域」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「標出共用依賴與獨立部分。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit failure domains input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
